comment: The guidance's other half (spec §4: never a block for a short answer). MEASURES: a one-line question gets no ```nova-ui block at all — an invalid attempt counts as one, since it lands in his bubble as code (ui_block_absent). WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: whether the answer is right. S54a T14 (spec docs/plans/rebuild/s54/spec.md §5): a new case is a new denominator, so suite_version moved 27 -> 28 for the S54a cases (all fifty-five). Scored off the turn's ui_blocks span, which chat.py files at the main persist boundary from ui_blocks.check() of the STORED reply, never off the reply's wording.
